title: Executive Program in Project Management and Digital Transformation
description: Embark on an 11-term learning journey in Project Management, Project Evaluation, Digital Strategy, and AI/ML Analytics.

content.title: who should join
points: Project Managers looking to enhance their skills in managing complex projects and driving digital initiatives.
Business Analysts aiming to understand and implement digital transformation strategies within organizations.
IT Managers seeking to lead digital transformation efforts and improve technology integration.
Operations Managers wanting to streamline processes and adopt digital tools for better efficiency.
Change Management Specialists interested in facilitating smooth transitions during digital transformations.
Consultants who advise clients on digital strategy and project management practices.
Product Managers aiming to oversee the development and deployment of digital products.
Marketing Managers looking to leverage digital tools and project management techniques in their campaigns.
HR Professionals wanting to manage digital projects related to human resources and talent management.
Finance Managers interested in overseeing digital transformation projects that impact financial systems.
Entrepreneurs and Start-up Founders aiming to implement digital strategies and manage projects efficiently in their ventures.

content.title: program snapshot
points: 11 Terms - Project Management, Project Evaluation, Digital Strategy
Learn from the top industry professionals

curriculum.title: Project Leadership & Advanced Topics
points: Leadership and Soft Skills for Project Managers

curriculum.title: Project Management Capstone
points: In this capstone project, you’ll develop a Project Management Excellence Framework for an organization. You’ll assess current project management practices, identify gaps,and benchmark against industry standards. The final deliverable is a comprehensive roadmap with actionable recommendations to enhance project management practices and support continuous improvement efforts

curriculum.title: Metrics, KPIs & ROI Evaluation
points: Key Metrics & KPIs in Digital Transformation
Evaluating ROI of Digital Transformation Initiatives

curriculum.title: Digital Transformation Capstone
points: Capstone Project allows participants to apply their knowledge to a real-world challenge, integrating digital strategy, business models, and change management. They will create a digital transformation plan, assess digital maturity, and measure success with KPIs and ROI, gaining the skills to lead digital transformation.

content.title: Do I need to have prior project management experience to enroll in the program?
content: No, the program is designed to be inclusive of all levels of experience. All topics will be covered from the basics, making it suitable for individuals from any field of work.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In Executive Program in Project Management and Digital Transformation you will have access to more than 30 assignments and 2 Capstone Projects to provide a better understanding of the real-world applications of project management concepts.

content.title: What's the difference between case studies & projects?
content: Case studies are targeted towards concept validation and limited to only a single concept. However, projects are targeted to overall learning and are more of a combination of multiple topics.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Executive Program in Project Management and Digital Transformation?
How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: Every term is for 4-5 weeks approximately. And the overall duration of Executive Program in Project Management and Digital Transformation is 12 months.

content.title: How's the Executive Program in Project Management and Digital Transformation different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Project Management concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
